title: Satisfaction After Linear Elimination
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite variable set, let $C$ be a list of variables, and let $R$ be a list of linear equations over $mathbb{F}_2$. For any assignment, it satisfies every equation in $R$ if and only if it satisfies every pivot equation recorded by eliminating along $C$ and every equation in the resulting residual list.
